action.newText: listDetailed preserves row order and assigns detail: null to rows beyond the detail limit or whose detail fetch fails. JobApprovals displays the raw permissionKey for these rows, even when a translated key label exists; successfully detailed rows retain their previews. BudgetBanner skips null-detail rows when building policy-to-request links, while successfully detailed rows continue to supply links.

rationale: The on-disk spec's US-007 AC-6 explicitly requires raw permissionKey. Source inspection also confirms JobApprovals is the read-only preview surface being migrated, distinct from the translated summary rows of the unified inbox.
